source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of selection sort (PDF 84).

blocks.text: Selection Sort ek aur saada sorting algorithm hai. Yeh list ke unsorted (be-tarteeb) hisse se sab se chhota element (ya sab se bara, jaisi tarteeb chahiye) chunta (select karta) hai aur use unsorted hisse ke pehle element se swap kar deta hai. Yahi amal list ke baqi unsorted hisse par dohraya jata hai.

items: List ke unsorted hisse mein sab se chhota (minimum) element dhoondein.
Use pehle unsorted element se swap karein.
Sorted aur unsorted hisson ki sarhad (boundary) ek element aage kar dein.
Baqi elements ke liye yahi amal dohrayein.

blocks.text: Misal: list [29,10,14,37,13] mein Selection Sort pehle sab se chhota element 10 dhoondega aur use 29 se swap karega. List [10,29,14,37,13] ban jayegi. Yeh amal list poori sort hone tak chalta hai.

blocks.caption: [29, 10, 14, 37, 13] par Selection Sort (pehla qadam kitab ka, baqi hamare hal kiye hue)

blocks.text: Complexity: Selection Sort ki time complexity O(n²) hai. Bubble Sort ki tarah yeh bare datasets ke liye efficient nahi, magar banana seedha aur aasan hai.

blocks.prompt: [29, 10, 14, 37, 13] par Selection Sort kitne swap karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Teen swap (qadam 1, 2 aur 4); qadam 3 mein 14 pehle se apni jagah par hai.

items: Selection Sort: unsorted hisse ka minimum chuno, aage swap karo; O(n²).
